rules.description: Property must be non-domestic and used for business purposes
rules.reason_if_failed: Business rates only apply to non-domestic properties used for business purposes

rules.description: Property must not be exempt from business rates
rules.reason_if_failed: Your property is exempt from business rates (e.g. farm buildings, welfare facilities for disabled people)

rules.description: Property must have a rateable value assigned by VOA
rules.reason_if_failed: Your property does not have a rateable value. Contact the Valuation Office Agency.

rules.description: Service is for properties in England or Wales only
rules.reason_if_failed: Business rates are handled differently in Scotland and Northern Ireland

rules.description: Self-catering properties in England must meet availability and occupancy criteria
rules.reason_if_failed: Self-catering properties must be available for at least 140 nights and let for at least 70 nights to pay business rates. Otherwise you pay Council Tax.

rules.description: Home-based businesses must meet business use criteria
rules.reason_if_failed: Small home offices usually only pay Council Tax. You may need business rates if you receive customers, employ staff, or have made structural changes.

explanation_template: Business rates eligibility: {outcome}. Rateable value: £{rateable_value}. Relief available: {relief_status}

edge_cases.description: Farm buildings used for agricultural purposes are exempt
edge_cases.action: Property is exempt. No business rates payable. Confirm with VOA if uncertain.

edge_cases.description: Stables used for farming horses are exempt
edge_cases.action: Exempt from business rates. May pay Council Tax if in domestic garden. Contact VOA to confirm.

edge_cases.description: Property affected by flooding, roadworks, or severe local disruption
edge_cases.action: Temporary reduction may be available. Report to VOA for assessment.

edge_cases.description: Property is part business, part domestic (e.g. live above shop)
edge_cases.action: You pay both business rates and Council Tax. Separate bills will be issued.

edge_cases.description: Business owner disputes the rateable value
edge_cases.action: Route to VOA business rates valuation account for challenge. Deadline: 31 March 2026 for current values.
